situations.title: Taking an auto
situations.subtitle: Ask a driver, agree on a meter, reach your stop

phrases.use: Asking the driver if they'll come to your destination.

phrases.english: I need to go to Indiranagar

phrases.use: Politely asking the driver to use the meter.
Asking the fare before or at the end of the ride.
Asking the driver to stop at your spot.

roleplay.title: Auto ride dialogue
roleplay.intro: You're in an auto. Pick the right Kannada reply for the driver's line. There's no wrong answer here — listen and try again whenever you like.

steps.speaker: driver
steps.lineEnglish: Where do you want to go?

options.feedback: Exactly! You told the driver your destination.
Nice try — that means 'please turn on the meter'. For 'where to go?' you'd say your destination. Listen once more and try again.
Nice try — that means 'how much?'. For 'where to go?' you'd say where you need to go. Listen once more and try again.

steps.speaker: driver
steps.lineEnglish: Shall I put the meter on?

options.feedback: Yes! That confirms you want the meter on.
Nice try — that means 'stop here'. The driver asked about the meter. Listen once more and try again.
Nice try — that's for asking if they'll come. The driver asked about the meter. Listen once more and try again.

steps.speaker: driver
steps.lineEnglish: We've arrived, sir. Please get down here.

options.feedback: Perfect — 'stop here, please' fits the moment.
Nice try — that's 'how much?', which you'd ask before paying. The driver said you've arrived. Listen once more and try again.
Nice try — you already told them that. They said you've arrived. Listen once more and try again.
